tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshes bcu'i dus mchod dang 'brel bar byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur bya ba'i tshul bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru pad+mā ka rā ya/ rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi// gsang gsum kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal// snying dbus pad+mo'i ze'u 'bru'i rtser// bzhugs la bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// de la 'dir bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshes bcu'i dus mchod dang 'brel bar gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma bskur bar spro na/ las gzhung gi dngos grub blang ba'i bar dkyus ltar song nas/ dkyil 'khor du tshogs pa'i 'dus pa rnams las gzhan pa gsar du 'jug na/ khrus bya/ bgegs phral/ srung 'khor bsgom pa rnams mdor bsdus tsam sngon du gtong*/ ji ltar yang slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ ji skad du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ rang 'dod las la rnal 'byor pas// cho ga ji bzhin sbyin par bya// mar gyi ngo yi tshes bcu dang*// zla ba yar ngor gyur pa la// myur du 'bad pas mchod bya ste// zhes dang*/ kun mkhyen chen po dri med 'od zer gyi zhal nas/ tshes bcu yar ngo mar ngo'i nyin dang mtshan// bsnyen sgrub skong bshags tshogs mchod 'bad par bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar yar ngo dang mar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus su phyi rol du yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams sgrub pa po'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyis 'du zhing*/ nang du rnal 'byor pa'i rtsa rlung thig le rnams thim dang longs spyod bdag po'i 'gros kyis dbu mar 'du bas nye ba'i 'du ba zhes dus khyad par du 'phags pa'i skabs 'dir snang grags rig gsum rdo rje'i rnal 'byor zab mo las mi 'da' ba'i sgo nas phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs kyi longs spyod kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bus yul dang dbang po gnyis su med pa'i bde chen rdo rje'i dam tshig gis mnyes par bya ba ni bsod nams dngos grub rgya mtsho'i nyer len mchog tu grub par ma zad/

rang cag gangs can pa'i 'gro ba rnams la sangs rgyas las kyang bka' drin ches rmad du byung ba'i skyabs dang*/ mgon dang dpung gnyen gcig pur gyur pa/ sras bcas rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dpal o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma saṃ bha was zhing 'dir ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i gtso bo rags rim rnams bstan pa dang*/ rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams la thugs rje'i gzugs dang khyad par can mngon sum du 'jug pas byin gyis rlob par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus kyang yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus chen 'di rnams yin pa'i tshul bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i zhal gdams las/ dbang chen sprel zla'i tshes bcu dang : dus kyi tshes bcu thams cad la: sprul pa 'dzam gling khyab par 'gyed: mchog thun dngos grub nga yis ster: zhes dang*/ rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyi gter byon mnga' bskyed nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ bod la bde bskyid 'byung 'dod na: yar ngo'i tshes bcu nam shar tshe: o rgyan pad+ma'i sprul pa 'byung : de dus nga la mos pa yis: rab kyis bskyed rdzogs gnas lugs ltos: phyi nang gsang ba'i sgrub pa tshugs: sems bskyed bsam pa bzang po yis: 'gro drug thugs rjes 'dren pa yi: las dang smon lam rgya cher thob: 'bring gis lus ngag yid gsum gyis: sgrib sbyong las la brtson par gyis: zhes dang*/ yang snying 'dus pa'i skul byang las/ nga nyid srin yul 'gro ba'i tshe: bod kyi rgyal blon sngags slob la: 'byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu'i dus: nga nyid 'byon pa'i dbu bsnyungs bzhes: pad+ma 'byung gnas gzhan mi bslu: the tshom spongs shig rjes 'jug rnams: las su rung ba'i blo yod na: 'di ltar nga yi tshes bcu la: brtson cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i bu: 'khor bar ltung na nges shes kyis: blo snying brang gsum nga la gtod: ces dang*/ zhal gdams gser phreng las/ sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes chen bcu yi nyinaḥ

o rgyan nga dngos bod yul thams cad du: nges par 'byon no nga yi tha tshig yin: byung ngo cog gi zla ba'i tshes bcu la: sprul pas gangs can khyab par mi 'byon re'i: tha tshig yin no pad 'byung bslu mi srid: mdor na nga yi rjes 'jug dad ldan rnams: spyod ldan gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba bshams: tshig bdun gsol 'debs gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas: thod pa ltag sprod rol mo'i sgra bskul na: o rgyan nga nyid rnga yab dpal ri nas: gces pa'i bus ngus ma yis mi bzod ltar: byin gyis rlob 'byon dam tshig na ra kan: zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa ltar spyi dang bye brag gi phan yon khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa'i dus bzang tshes bcu'i mchod pa'i dngos grub blang ba'i cho ga dang rjes su 'brel bar/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol gar gter ston grub thob thams cad kyi rgyal po gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gis lho brag mkhar chu gnam skas can nas spyan drangs pa'i bla ma'i thugs sgrub gsang ba 'dus pa'i gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma dang*/ rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa'i bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i rab 'byams bka'i dbang bskur las 'byung ba'i gtor dbang ste/ brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pa'i byin rlabs dbang bskur gyi rim pa zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hoḥ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dgongs: rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du: bdag cag 'jug cing bsnyen sgrub spro: gus pas 'jug 'dod bstan du gsol: zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ spro na/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar skyabs gnas rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

ces brda sbyar la las gzhung gi skyabs sems lan gsum/ byin rlabs kyi gzhi brtan par byed pa ye shes dbab pa'i slad du/ khyed rang rnams skad cig dran rdzogs su chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul gyis pad+ma nyi zla bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du gzhi lus kyi bkod pa dbang chen rta mchog he ru ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas rang 'od kyi yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab yum gyi spyi bor rta gdong dang phag zhal bzhad cing dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyangs bskums gar gyi rol pas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i sku can du lam gyis gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar ser rnams kyis mtshan pa las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas rang bzhin gyis gnas dang*/ rnga yab dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing nas rab 'byams rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du spyan drangs te sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ spyan 'dren rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ dz+nyā na badz+ra ā be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes byin dbab/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ de ltar ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya ba sngon du song nas byin rlabs gtor ma'i dbang bskur ba dngos la'ang*/ gtor mchod dus su gtor mar shes pa/ dbang gi dus su lhar shes pa/ dngos grub blang ba'i dus su dam rdzas su shes pa ste gsum las/ 'dir dbang dus su lhar shes pa yin pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'byung ba rim brtsegs rin chen 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rtsa gsum kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal yab yum mtshan dpe'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar ba/

rgyan cha lugs thams cad ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa chu zla'am 'ja' tshon lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga lte bar hrīḥdamar ser rnams kyis mtshan par gyur pa las dngos su 'byor pa dang yid kyis sprul pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas slar yang bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo rdo rje thod phreng rtsal tha mi dad pa la mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs drag pos dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol snyam pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon 'dren pa'i gtso: bdag cag las 'phro skal bar ldan: rang gzhan don kun bsgrub bya'i phyir: dbang chen yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: de nas gtor ma bteg la/ zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed gtor ma lhar gsal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul te sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi rang sgra sgrogs/ thugs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgo 'phar brgya phrag tu dbye bzhin pas so so rang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum lta bur byon nas/ spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po oṃ yig gi phreng ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i oṃ la thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po āḥyig gi phreng ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa'i āḥl thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/

ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po hūm̐ yig gi phreng ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu thugs rdo rje chos kyi sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ lte ba'i hrīḥlas 'od zer dmar ser hrīḥyig gi phreng ba dang bcas pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi lte ba'i hrīḥl thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ bag chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas pa'i mos pa dung dung mdzod/ e ma hoḥ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: bla ma rnams dang gcig pa la: yi dam lha dang dbyer med cing : mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas: rtsa ba gsum gyi byin rlabs kyis: sku gsung thugs dbang yongs rdzogs pa: skal ldan 'di la bskur thob shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ḥ gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī kā ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ: wāka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ḥ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñca oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ kā ya wāka tsit+ta rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhāḥ zhes dzab dbyangs dang bcas te gtor ma spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su reg cing*/ slar yang gtor ma'i bla ma nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon nas 'bral med du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces dang rtsa sngags brjod cing gtor ma spyi bor bzhag mthar gtor ma dngos grub tu shes pa ni/

khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor bla ma dang rtsa khams dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor mar dag pas/ gtor ma dngos grub kyi bdud rtsir 'khyil pa de rol pas dngos grub rnam gnyis bde blag tu 'grub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod de gtor ma'i mtha' ras dngos grub kyi rdzas su sbyin cing tshe ril g.yas dang tshe chang g.yon skor du 'gyed/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas mtha' brten shis par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ bye brag tu yang bder gshegs kun 'dus rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma lha dang drang srong bden tshig grub pa'i tshogs kyis bskor te shis pa brjod pa'i glu dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs shing me tog man+dā ra'i char chen po phab pas shin tu bkra shis par byas pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba la sogs pa'i shes brjod ji ltar rigs pa dang bcas te me tog gi char phab/ spro na dam tshig khas blang ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o// rtsa gsum kun 'dus mtsho skyes rje'i// byin rlabs dbang bskur rim pa 'dis// 'gro kun rnga yab dpal gyi rir// 'jug pa'i lam bzang nyid gyur cig /bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang 'brel bar gtor dbang gnad kyi shog gcig ma ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul bklags chog tu bkod pa 'di'ang*/ shākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs kyis sbyar ba'i dge bas mtha' klas pa'i yid can rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed pad+ma drwa ba can gyi dga' tshal du 'dod rgur rtsen pa'i rgyur gyur cig 'di nyid dus gzhan du byed pa'i tshe tshes bcu'i phan yon dor te/ de'i tshab tu spro na gsar rnying bka' gter gyi dbye ba dang 'brel bar gu ru rin po che'i che ba ji ltar rigs pa brjod cing*/ ma nus na sems bskyed gsal gdab nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos sogs la 'jug pas chog go/

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
